trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Evergreen Catering has two approved invoices and I'm not sure which one you mean:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-54311 | $1,794.66 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-64706 | $5,952.39 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices can't be paid now. INV-26736 ($3,496.54) is already paid, and INV-43342 ($1,821.44) is still a draft waiting for approval. There are no payments from the operating account yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which should I pay: INV-54311, INV-64706 or both? Once you tell me, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), pay it only once and send you the payment details. Both are under $10,000, so they don't need the controller's approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-64706, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-64706, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-64706 in full by wire, and it went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-64706 (Evergreen Catering), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $5,952.39
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent and confirmed, and the invoice is marked paid

I attached a one-time key to the payment so it can't go out twice. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need the controller's approval. I didn't touch INV-54311 because it's under dispute.
